unit: provider requests actually sent; every sent request counts -- success, failure, timeout and truncation alike

content_support_verification.why_none_reusable: the 5 saved LLM verdicts on these claims (c904d4cc) record no model, prompt, budget or raw response -- the task never reaches the call ledger (not in llm_runtime.contracts.SEMANTIC_TASKS); none of the 17 claims is resolved by the deterministic data-fact verifier

evidence_stance_classifier.why_none_reusable: no saved LLM stance exists for these claims (budget_exhausted in 034a0a60 and 1bad76a7; not run in c904d4cc)
evidence_stance_classifier.basis: (claim, Alpha) items batched 10 per request within each run (the production pass runs once per run); replayed Alpha answers give their exact item count (zero calls), every other sample is counted at the maximum 3 targets; the real count depends on the new Alpha answers

other_tasks.why: no Fresh run, no adapter / structure-extractor / TradingAgents request; the five links need none

cap_mechanism: each task has its own production gateway whose call budget (max_calls) reserves one call per attempt; with application retries 0 and SDK retries 0 the cap is the exact number of requests that task can send; a request refused locally (input too large) is not sent and not reserved
usage_accounting: reported only from the provider's own usage fields per request; a request with no usage (e.g. timeout) is reported as usage missing, never estimated; a timed-out request may still be processed and billed by the provider
